verdict.line: You lose if you let Sion's Q (Cryptic Gaze) stun land and he strings an Enrage auto chain on you before level 3; you win if you hook him out of that Q wind-up and snowball the bleed before his Cannibalism sustain comes online.

brief.thesis: This matchup lives and dies on interrupting Sion's Q (Cryptic Gaze) wind-up. Darius has the lane and solo-kill edge (56.3% over 160 games) because E (Apprehend, range 535) can yank Sion out of that cast before the stun resolves, and once he's hooked he's standing in bleed range with no disengage. The overall shape reads even because Sion's kit is a late-game HP-stacking snowball, so the matchup is Darius-favoured in lane but Sion's E (Enrage) scaling claws the gap back if the game goes long.

theirWindow.what: Before your E is online you have no way to punish or escape a landed Cryptic Gaze stun; respect his 550 range and don't facecheck free autos into his Enrage toggle while you're rooted.

yourWindow.what: Fire E (Apprehend) the instant you see the Cryptic Gaze wind-up start - the pull interrupts the cast and drags him into your bleed stacks, exactly the tech this matchup is built around.

start.why: Runs 56.9% winrate over 188 games at 90.4% pick - the extra sustain and on-hit damage keeps you even in early auto trades while you wait for E.

boots.why: 49% winrate over 96 games at 47.8% pick - Sion's Enrage toggle turns his autos into real physical burst, and Steelcaps blunts exactly that.

Closes the 67.7% path - bleeds through his Enrage self-damage trades and converts the physical damage he does land into delayed, healable damage.

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through the exact auto-trade loop this lane forces once you've hooked Sion with E. Master-tier Darius players instead run Stormraider's Surge (Sorcery, 2,344 games) for the burst of movement speed - better if you plan to all-in off E and leave rather than grind out a stacked trade.

summoners.why: 56.1% winrate at 80.3% pick - Ghost closes the distance faster than Sion can walk away after a landed Apprehend pull and backs up his already-favoured solo-kill rate.

playing.title: Interrupt Cryptic Gaze with E
playing.detail: Sion's Q has a visible wind-up before the stun resolves. From level 3 on, hook him mid-channel with E (Apprehend, 535 range) to cancel the cast entirely and drag him into bleed range.

playing.title: Track the Enrage toggle
playing.detail: Once Sion flips E on he's trading his own HP for AD on every auto. Commit to the trade - your Hemorrhage stacks and W (Crippling Strike) slow punish him for standing in it longer than you do.

playing.title: Threaten R at max Hemorrhage
playing.detail: At 5 stacks of Hemorrhage, Noxian Guillotine's true damage spikes hard. Slow him with W first so he can't walk out of your 460-range leap before the execute lands.

playing.title: Abuse the solo-kill edge pre-6
playing.detail: Data confirms a solo-kill advantage for Darius. Look to force all-ins before Sion hits level 6, since his Cannibalism sustain and attack-speed leech aren't live yet to bail him out.

playing.title: Don't dump your combo into his W shield
playing.detail: Death's Caress (8s cooldown) absorbs damage and can be detonated early by Sion. Bait the shield down with autos before committing your full E-into-R combo.

playing.title: Deny him kills after level 11
playing.detail: Sion's E permanently raises his max HP on every kill, including minions and jungle camps. Don't let him freefarm uncontested waves once Cannibalism is up - every stack he banks makes him harder to burst later.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample-size figures are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning - the Q-interrupt tech, the Enrage trade windows, the stack timing - is this brief's own tactical read, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Pull Sion with [E] when he is charging up his (Q) to interrupt it. Avoid his (E)-(Q) combo while gaining lane control.
